analyst.summary: Gland Pharma is India's largest sterile-injectables manufacturer, benefiting from a recovering European CDMO business (Cenexi) alongside its core US-focused injectables franchise, with strong recent revenue and margin growth. The company's own growth guidance for next year is more modest than the recent quarter's headline profit growth would suggest, and part of the reported profit jump likely reflects items below the core operating line. We rate this a Hold: a well-run, debt-free business, but the valuation appears to price in upside (from potential GLP-1 drug opportunities) that is not yet guaranteed.
